text:
alex: Quick heads-up — we're proposing a phased sunset for the client-side compatibility adapter that translates v1 -> v2 shapes. TL;DR: 90-day adapter opt-in window, tenant-level grace periods for enterprise, and a limited compatibility proxy for customers who can't upgrade immediately.

maria: Can you share concrete migration steps? Is streaming behavior going to be incompatible?

alex: Streaming is the main pain point. v2 emits chunked newline-delimited events (ndjson style) and we remove the legacy "event_type" envelope. The compatibility proxy will rewrap events for legacy clients for up to 90 days, but note: it doesn't replicate the old long-poll batching optimizations.

samir: We need per-tenant telemetry for who uses the adapter + an emergency kill switch. Also SLA impact?

alex: Plan: emit adapter_count, adapter_p50, adapter_errors per-tenant in the Console. Add a server-side feature flag: `rw.compat-adapter.enabled` and an admin kill switch we can flip per-tenant. We'll mark proxy requests in logs with `rw_compat_proxy=true`.

jin: What about SDKs? We should avoid a mass break for users pinned to old SDKs.

louise-sdk: We'll ship small SDKs that negotiate via header `x-rw-client-api: v2` and fall back to legacy. That lets us auto-upgrade where possible. We'll need coordination with DevEx for migration notes and changelogs.

maria: Also worry about mobile apps that can't update quickly. Suggest we provide an nginx/edge example and a simple proxy binary they can drop in front of their apps.

alex: Agreed. Also proposing an "adapter audit" job: scan access logs and surface endpoints still calling the adapter, with last_seen timestamps and owner contact if available.

dave-bot: deploy-bot: Compatibility proxy v1.3 deployed to staging at 2234568000.

samir: Saw the staging numbers — proxy adds ~40ms p50 on short requests. For high-qps tenants we should enable a fast-path that prefers v2 if client advertises it to reduce overhead. Also consider adaptive batching changes.

alex: Rollout plan draft: 
- Week 0: announce + migration docs + migration repo
- Week 2: enable telemetry (opt-in for private installs)
- Week 4: proxy in staging + early-access tenants
- Week 8: open opt-in enforcement window (console will show flagged tenants)
- Week 12: new tenants default to v2 only (no auto-compat)
- Week 16: begin soft-sunset, 90-day countdown for remaining tenants
- Week 24: hard cut — deny requests with legacy header unless tenant has approved grace

maria: Add partner comms: email + console banner 60 days before hard cut. Also call out mobile SDK owners separately.

samir: Can enterprise customers request an extension? We may need a process for grace periods and billing implications.

alex: Yes — enterprise can request up to 180-day grace via support ticket. We will log grace requests and expose them to the Console team so they can show the remaining grace time on tenant dashboards.

jin: From infra side: provide a checklist for routing/canary/circuit-breaker changes. Proxy increases error surface; add circuit-breaker thresholds and tactical fallbacks to a read-only mode.

louise-sdk: SDK migration plan: publish `rw-client-compat` (js) and `redwood_compat_adapter` (py) helpers that: negotiate header, buffer legacy frames, and expose a migration flag. We'll also include an automated test harness to validate behavior against the proxy.

alex: Telemetry event sample (for ingestion):
```json
{
  "tenant_id": "t-12345",
  "timestamp": 2234568100,
  "adapter_used": true,
  "adapter_latency_ms": 42
}
```

maria: Please also add a self-hosted fallback nginx snippet for customers who can't run our proxy. Keep it tiny.

samir: +1 to perf test suite. We should gate the proxy changes with nightly perf runs to guard against regressions.

alex: Risks to call out in the RFC:
- increased p50 for short requests
- edge cases in streaming reassembly (lossy clients)
- extra operational burden for on-prem installs (telemetry opt-in required)

maria: Communication cadence proposal: initial announcement, weekly migration digest, and a migration office hours every Thursday during the opt-in period.

alex: Final ask: folks — please review the draft RFC at `docs/migration/compat-exit-plan.md` and the sample proxy in `github.com/redwood/compat-proxy` by EOD Friday. Mark any objections inline; we want migration owners assigned before next week's all-hands. :pray:

louise-sdk: Adding follow-up: we'll open a PR for SDK patches and a CHANGELOG entry in the migration repo.

jin: I'll prepare the infra checklist and a canary playbook.

samir: I'll own the telemetry dashboard and perf gating.

alex: Thanks all. If anyone needs a tenant list for outreach, ping me and I'll share.
